name: GiftAidClaimBuilder
tagline: Claim every penny of Gift Aid – declarations, eligibility, batches, HMRC schedules and donor statements in one app.
description: A complete Gift Aid app for UK charities: checks every gift against the declaration, taxpayer, benefit, address and 4-year deadline rules, builds claim batches with an HMRC-style schedule and aggregated small gifts, tracks submission, payment, rejections and refunds, and produces year-end donor statements.
features: Declarations: written, online, oral, cover-from, cancellation
Claim batches with problems and limits
HMRC-style schedule with aggregated small gifts and sponsored flag
Submission reference, payment and difference reason
